en: Job 20

p.src: 1  Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

en: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,
u.src: 1  Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

p.src: 2  “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

en: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.
u.src: 2  “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

p.src: 3  I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

p.src: 4  Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

en: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
u.src: 4  Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

p.src: 5  that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

en: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

en: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

p.src: 7  yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

p.src: 9  The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

en: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

p.src: 11  His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

en: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

p.src: 12  “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

en: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

u.src: 13  though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

p.src: 19  For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

en: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.
